name: Mestrel, Camp Warden
summary: Rewards the turn's second draw: the more cards flow, the harder it hits.

face.name: Mestrel, Camp Warden

tally.text: When you draw your second card in a turn, Mestrel gets +1 Power for each card drawn beyond the first this turn, until end of turn.

face.flavor: It counts cards like sentries: at the second, it sounds the alarm.
